newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion tracks global trends, end lower.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion tracks global trends, end lower.

text.p: Silver prices extended losses towards the close of trading on Friday amid sluggish industrial enquiries and a weak global trend, dealers said.
Silver was up by 30 rupees per kg on Thursday. "Improved arrivals of imported metal also hurt prices," a trader said.
Gold opened on a steady note but reports of setback in the world market dragged prices downward towards the close. Supplies were also rather poor.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 150 rupees lower at 60,300 rupees per piece. It was up by 150 rupees on Thursday.
